snippet.title: Attacking the Tower - Title Theme and Teaser (Henry Stickmin Fangame)
snippet.description:
2025 UPDATE: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7QEgU2P_MGs

Listen here on Newgrounds ► https://www.newgrounds.com/audio/listen/1022320

COOL LINKS:
Discord ► https://discord.gg/3hMu6Pk
Twitter ► https://twitter.com/StrobeDevs
Newgrounds ► https://strobeinteractive.newgrounds.com/
Itch.io ► https://strobeinteractive.itch.io/attackingthetower
Gamejolt ► https://gamejolt.com/games/attackingthetower/540973 

Attacking the Tower is a full-length Henry Stickmin fangame/love letter to the series being made in Adobe Animate by a group of fans known as Strobe Interactive.

The Team:
@franciscobhagwanmusic (Project Director, Music, Sound Design, Voices, Programming)
https://kejayco.newgrounds.com/
https://franciscobhagwan.com/

@Arguswastaken (Visual Director, Animation, Artwork, Music, Voices)
https://arguswastaken.newgrounds.com/

@GasGrass4 (Voices, Music, Animation, Artwork)
https://gasgrass.newgrounds.com/

@BioPlantHeyo (Animation, Artwork)
https://bioplant.newgrounds.com/
https://www.youtube.com/@BioPlantHeyo

@LocoBoy_95 (Artwork)
https://legoboy95.newgrounds.com/

Tomás Ferrer (Animation)
https://tomasferrer.newgrounds.com/
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCd3SXJcoGxUAnYH-9cch58w

Attacking the Tower is a fangame and by no means a part of the official series. Henry Stickmin and The Henry Stickmin Collection is created by PuffballsUnited and Innersloth.

#attackingthetower #henrystickmin #fangame
